text:
EXACT TEXT, so the fix cannot over-correct. README lines 83-85:

  'embed-grakern provides the JVM structural channel. The repository does not yet
   include an unattended text->AMR parser, an LLM acquisition adapter, an HTTP/ONNX
   provider, or calibrated production defaults.'

FOUR ITEMS ARE DENIED. EXACTLY ONE HAS CHANGED:

  unattended text->AMR parser      STILL TRUE  -- Stage 1b, measured at 4 of 50 sentences
  LLM acquisition adapter          STILL TRUE
  HTTP/ONNX provider               HALF FALSE  -- ONNX landed at 75bc1c5; HTTP has not,
                                                  embed-transport is deliberately unassigned
  calibrated production defaults   STILL TRUE  -- the external floor is uncalibrated, which is
                                                  precisely why Leg F went upstream of calibration

SO THE FIX IS TO SPLIT ONE SLASHED PAIR, not to rewrite the paragraph. 'an HTTP/ONNX provider' becomes something like 'an HTTP provider' in the denial list, with the local ONNX provider stated separately and accurately.

THE PAIRING IS ITSELF THE DEFECT AND IT IS WORTH NAMING: 'HTTP/ONNX' bundles a TRANSPORT with a RUNTIME as though they were one capability. They are not, they landed on different schedules, and one of them never needed the owner's API key while the other cannot exist without it. A slash that joins two independently-true facts will always go stale as soon as one of them changes -- and it did.

Whoever takes this: do not touch lines 3-4. 'Pre-release. No library artifact has been released; APIs will change without notice' stays verbatim.
